original_content_full:
Welcome Daniel and Sebastian!

We warmly welcome Daniel Müller and Sebastian Kay Belle as new members and PhD students in our Computer Graphics Systems group. Both joined our group already in August 2012. As members of the CGS group, Daniel and Sebastian plan to research on visualization technologies to support analysis and understanding of complex software system.
